recipe.visualDefinition: A sophisticated studio portrait featuring a woman in a shimmering purple iridescent gown standing behind a dark red velvet sofa, set against a backdrop of warm, vertical gold-toned curtains with dramatic spotlighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically and horizontally against a rhythmic curtain backdrop
High-contrast relationship between the cool purple dress and warm gold/red environment
Textual elements anchored in the top-left quadrant to balance the subject's central mass
Dramatic spotlighting creating a diagonal beam across the background
coreInvariants: Iridescent purple fabric with visible sheen
Vertical curtain folds providing linear texture
Deep red velvet furniture in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length standing figure, centered, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright iridescent sheen on the chest of the gown.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the vertical lines of the dress to the sofa, then sweeps up the left side to the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced between the upper left and right corners within the curtain folds.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject's dress against muted, mid-value warm tones in the background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thin hairlines and thick stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: Stacked layout with varying line lengths to create a block-like shape

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in negative space of background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for title paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for the artist name.
graphicDevices: Ellipsis at the end of the title
Horizontal rule-like alignment of left margins

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif aesthetic
Clean sans-serif for the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A glamorous studio portrait of a woman in a shimmering purple iridescent gown standing behind a dark red velvet sofa. The background consists of vertical gold-toned curtain folds with a diagonal spotlight beam. High-end fashion lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a four-line stacked title in the top-left corner using a high-contrast Didone serif in cream. Below it, add a single line of text in a magenta sans-serif font, aligned to the left margin.

verificationChecks: Is the title stacked in the top-left?
Are the curtains gold and vertically folded?
Is the sofa dark red velvet?

adjustableVariables: Dress color (could be emerald or gold)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the iridescent sheen on the dress looks realistic
Check that the typography does not overlap the subject's hair
Verify the diagonal light beam is visible but not distracting
Confirm the red of the sofa and the purple of the dress harmonize
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered fashion subject in a high-sheen garment with a textured, vertically-oriented background and a top-left justified, high-contrast serif typographic block.
